messages:
From: Dana Ruiz <dana@fallboard.xyz>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fallboard cohort — promo allocation & short extension

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost controls. Fallboard is finalizing our September cohort and we have three teams that would be a very strong fit for Redwood (privacy-forward fintech, docs AI for SMBs, and an internal dev tools startup).

Two asks:
1) A promotional allocation for the cohort: 120k token-equivalent credits split across three teams for 12 weeks.
2) A brief trial extension for two teams whose evaluation windows close on 8/31 — could we extend their self-serve trial to 9/14 while we finalize paperwork?

We have a term sheet attached and the cohort roster in CSV. If you can approve in principle, I’ll route the paperwork and share the HubSpot company record.

Best,
Dana Ruiz
Program Director, Fallboard Inc.
attachments: fallboard-term-sheet.pdf (application/pdf), cohort-roster.csv (text/csv)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Ruiz <dana@fallboard.xyz>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fallboard cohort — promo allocation & short extension

Dana — thanks for the note and for the materials. Quick responses: 
- We can provision a promotional allocation in that ballpark (120k token-equivalent) but need to confirm split and milestone gating.
- Trial extension for the two evaluation accounts to 2026-09-14 is reasonable from a hosted-API perspective.

Could I loop in Marissa (growth credits owner) to confirm the allocation structure and any conditional terms? If Marissa signs off, I’ll follow up with a short mutual action plan and a DocuSign for the cohort-wide promo terms.

A couple of clarifying Qs for Marissa:
- Do we want a single promo code applied at the company level or three account-level grants?
- Any carve-outs for Dedicated/Dedicated-like usage (we usually exclude reserved capacity in promo grants unless specifically requested)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Growth
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Dana Ruiz <dana@fallboard.xyz>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fallboard cohort — promo allocation & short extension

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed the term sheet and cohort roster. We can approve a 120k token-equivalent grant with the following conditions: 

- Structure: 1 company-level promo allocation, but we will create three sub-allocations (40k each) tracked to the team accounts on HubSpot.
- Duration: valid for 12 weeks starting the activation date.
- Trial extension: extend two evaluation accounts to 2026-09-14 as requested.
- Usage gating: any single team exceeding 60% of its sub-allocation before week 6 triggers a usage review and potential throttle; we’ll proactively notify the Fallboard program lead.
- Compliance: no Dedicated/reserved capacity usage; hosted API only for the promo.

Next steps for Dana: please confirm the team account emails and indicate which two accounts need the trial extension. Once we have that, I’ll generate the promo code, add the HubSpot PO, and send a short DocuSign that formalizes the allocation and gating.

Logan — I put this under deal DB-2026-FB-029 in HubSpot (link below). I’ll attach the promo code and the sign-off doc once Dana confirms.

Marissa Cole
Growth Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
